definitions.explanation: The melting of accumulated snow, especially as managed on roads and roofs in snowy regions; also seen in the names of equipment and agents for melting snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{融雪|ゆうせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{融雪|ゆうせつ}⟦パイプ→パイプ：00338_paipu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{埋|う}めてある→埋める：01901_umeru⟧。
examples.english: Snow-melting pipes are buried in the road.

examples.japanese: {融雪|ゆうせつ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{増水|ぞうすい}→増水：16507_zousui⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Rising water from snowmelt can make rivers dangerous.

notes:
The melting of accumulated snow. In snowy regions it often refers to engineered snow removal: {融雪|ゆうせつ}⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧ (snow-melting systems) spray warm water or run heat beneath roads.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {融雪|ゆうせつ}{剤|ざい}: snow-melting agent (de-icer)
- {融雪|ゆうせつ}⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧: snow-melting equipment
- {融雪|ゆうせつ}{期|き}: the thaw season

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雪解|ゆきど}け→雪解け：08558_yukidoke⟧: thaw — the everyday word for snow melting in spring
